description: This file defines the ApplicationViewFileProvider class, a custom implementation of IFileProvider for serving application module view files in OrchardCore, handling directory contents, file info, and change tokens based on application paths.

classes.name: ApplicationViewFileProvider
classes.description: A custom file provider that serves application module view files, supporting directory listing, file info retrieval, and change monitoring based on application paths.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns directory contents for a given subpath, serving physical directories for module paths and specific folders like 'Pages' or 'Views'.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information for a given subpath, serving physical files from the application root.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Creates a change token to monitor changes in files under the specified filter path.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes and trims slashes for consistent path handling.
